I don't like Maths very much because it's difficult for me. Every day I have five lessons, and school starts at half past eight. I usually go to school by bus because I live quite far away. After lessons, I stay for the chess club twice a week — I've learned to play really well this year. At lunchtime, we have pizza in the canteen, but only on Fridays. My best friend Lucy is in my class, and we always sit together.

tasks.audio: Hi, I'm Max. My hobby is collecting postcards from different countries. I started three years ago when my aunt gave me a postcard from Spain. Now I have more than eighty postcards in my collection. I keep them in a special album, and I look at them every weekend. My favourite postcard is from Japan because it has a picture of a beautiful mountain. I spend about two hours a week on my hobby, usually on Saturdays. My best friend Kate doesn't collect postcards, but she likes looking at my collection with me. Next year I want to visit a postcard exhibition in our city. My mum says my hobby teaches me about geography and different cultures.

tasks.audio: Hi, I'm Vika. I have a hamster called Fluffy. I got him two months ago as a birthday present from my parents. Fluffy lives in a cage in my bedroom, and he loves running in his wheel at night — sometimes the noise wakes me up! I feed him every morning before school, and he especially likes sunflower seeds. Fluffy sleeps most of the day and becomes active in the evening. Last week, he escaped from his cage and hid behind my bookshelf for two hours. I was very worried, but my brother found him safe and sound. Now I always check that the cage door is properly closed. My friends think hamsters are boring, but I love watching Fluffy explore his cage.

Spring is nice too, especially when the flowers start to bloom in our garden. My mum says the weather in our city changes very quickly, so we always check the forecast before going out.

I don't really like cooking myself, but on Saturdays my grandmother comes over and we bake a cake together — I love mixing the flour and sugar with her. My little brother is different from me: he doesn't eat vegetables at all and only wants meat. In the evening, my whole family eats dinner together at six o'clock, and we always talk about our day.
